summary: Iteration 8 — E2E test of new JWT Bearer auth + role-based service requests. Backend: 12/13 pytest passed, 1 skipped (no 'other-user' request available for cliente). Frontend Playwright: every review-request bullet verified live on preview URL. Cliente cannot see admin panel, cannot access /assets, sees only their own solicitudes; admin sees 18 rows including SRV+SOL, updates status which persists after reload; register flow, logout, role labels in header all work. Only carry-over issue: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle a11y warning on success modal (already flagged iteration 7).

issues: Still emits Radix a11y warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle`. Wrap in VisuallyHidden or add a hidden title. (Carry-over from iteration 7 — main agent has not fixed.)

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add a DialogTitle (visually hidden) inside the success-modal DialogContent in NuevaSolicitud.js to silence Radix a11y warning. This has been an open item since iteration 7.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_can_view` uses raw dict field `email` (QR requests) vs `owner_email` (service). Consider a unified `owner_email` field on public reports linked-by-email so cliente listing/permissions stay in sync.
get_current_user still reads cookies AND Authorization header — fine, but doc/expected canonical scheme now is Bearer; consider dropping cookie code-path or documenting dual support.
server.py is 707 lines — near the 700-line refactor threshold; consider splitting auth/users/assets/requests/uploads into modules.

MisSolicitudes.js maps `s.origin === 'servicio' ? s.service_type : 'Mantenimiento'` — hard-codes 'Mantenimiento' for all QR reports which may be misleading if a QR report is really an audit/installation.

Frontend AuthContext exposes both `isAdmin` and `isCliente` but `isCliente = user && user.role !== 'admin'` — any non-admin role becomes 'cliente'. Fine today, but if a new role is introduced later this will be wrong.
seed_data_creation: Cliente created 3 SRV-2026-00000X during test run; admin advanced one to 'Validación' with comment 'TEST admin advance'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is Bearer JWT via header (localStorage 'ot_token'); backend still accepts cookie too. Use /app/backend/tests/test_auth_roles.py as regression. Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_auth_roles.py -o addopts= -v`.
